content:
sam: Deploybot auto-halted promote for v2.4.3 -> staging. Reason: manifestlist missing arm64 index in GCR target. We pushed amd64 but arm64 manifest entry absent. anyone seen this before?

deploybot: publish-check FAIL: manifest-list validation failed for image gcr.io/redwood/release:v2.4.3 - missing platform linux/arm64. Attestation absent for target platform.

anya: we build multi-arch on CI. the manifestlist should have both amd64 and arm64. CI logs show arm64 artifact skipped due to a flaky runner yesterday: https://ci.redwood/builds/8456#steps

infra-bot: note: retagging a manifest to add platform via gcrane requires that the target digest has layers present in repo. if layers missing, clients will fail. runbook: https://go/runbooks/gcr-manifest-annotate

lee: options: (1) rebuild arm64 and re-push (preferred, preserves provenance) (2) create a manual manifest entry pointing to the existing arm64 digest in another repo/account if layers exist (risky for provenance) (3) promote amd64-only temporarily and mark release as "amd64-only" (breaking for some customers). Product preference?

product-lead: change window 15:30-16:30 UTC. we need to avoid a cross-region customer-facing outage. can we do a quick patch? if rebuild <45m we prefer wait; else postpone release.

sam: quick investigation shows arm64 digest exists in staging-eu repo: sha256:deadbeef... but not in the canonical gcr repo. we could annotate the manifestlist to point to that digest, but the attestation in canonical repo won't exist. deploybot blocks promotion without attestation for every platform.

anya: rebuild estimate ~35-50m because arm runners are busy. I'll kick a rebuild now and watch.

sam: commands if we opted to annotate manually (not our first choice):
```
# copy layers or ensure digest present
gcloud auth configure-docker gcr.io && 
crane cp gcr.io/redwood/staging-arm@sha256:deadbeef gcr.io/redwood/release@sha256:deadbeef
# add platform entry to manifestlist
gcrane manifest annotate gcr.io/redwood/release:v2.4.3 --arch arm64 --os linux --digest sha256:deadbeef
```

infra-bot: reminder: manual annotate path will require manual attestation step: cosign sign must be executed in the target repo context and the certificate uploaded to our attestation store. audit will flag manual ops.

anya: rebuild job started -> https://ci.redwood/builds/8457. ETA ~40m.

deploybot: status watch: publish-check waiting for attestation. current hold will auto-expire if new attestation appears.

product-lead: ok wait up to 45m. if not green by 16:15 UTC postpone to next window and update release notes.

sam: noted. i'll monitor and prepare release note text in case we postpone. draft: "Release v2.4.3 delayed due to missing arm64 artifact during publish; fix in progress."

lee: quick post-action: add CI lint so multi-arch manifestlists fail fast when an arch is skipped, and add a deploybot check that reports which platforms lack attestations. ticket created: https://github.com/redwood/infra/issues/1147

anya: CI finished -> arm64 built and pushed, cosign attestation attached. deploybot: publish-check re-run -> PASS; manifestlist now contains linux/arm64 and linux/amd64.

deploybot: publish-check PASS. Promotion allowed.

sam: rolling canary now. product confirmed no postponement needed. i'll file a short blameless note linking CI run and ticket.

product-lead: thanks all, nice recovery. update release notes: "Fixed brief publish delay caused by missing arm64 artifact; deployment completed within change window."

lee: follow-up todo: ensure ci queue prioritizes arch-critical runners during release windows. created follow-up PR https://github.com/redwood/ci/pull/256
